crossRefs.note: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and…
Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was…
The servant took ten of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He…
He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East.…
God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.
You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.
